title: 磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制
summary: 本課聚焦以空間頻譜與測量不確定度控制磁浮導梁精度。從導向道測量角度誤差建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把不平順波長轉換與理想吸力模型的適用邊界連成可驗證的介面，最後以有限合格紀錄的外推整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies maglev guideway precision through spatial spectra and survey uncertainty. Start with angular error in guideway surveying to define physical or information boundaries, connect converting irregularity wavelengths with limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through extrapolating finite successful records. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 導向道測量角度誤差與精度帳的獨立與相關成分
stages.titleEn: Angular error in guideway surveying & Independent and correlated precision terms
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導向道測量角度誤差」與「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Angular error in guideway surveying" and "Independent and correlated precision terms": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導向道測量角度誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Angular error in guideway surveying: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導向道測量角度誤差」如何影響磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Angular error in guideway surveying” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guideway precision control for maglev”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先由視距與微小角度誤差估算橫向偏移，辨認長視線對控制網的影響。再用獨立站點和閉合差交叉檢查，避免共同基準錯誤被重複性掩蓋。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導向道測量角度誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity. Cross-check independent stations and closure so repeatability cannot hide a shared datum fault. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Angular error in guideway surveying” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導向道測量角度誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Angular error in guideway surveying”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 導向道測量角度誤差
knowledge.text: 先由視距與微小角度誤差估算橫向偏移，辨認長視線對控制網的影響。再用獨立站點和閉合差交叉檢查，避免共同基準錯誤被重複性掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity. Cross-check independent stations and closure so repeatability cannot hide a shared datum fault.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制」的「導向道測量角度誤差：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出車輛、軌道、牽引供電、號誌與旅客的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「列車性能與時刻表室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與版本一致的速度、時間、位置、負載及控制紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Angular error in guideway surveying: mechanism and system paths” in “Guideway precision control for maglev”. Draw the vehicle, track, traction, signaling and passenger interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Train performance and timetable room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for version-aligned speed, time, position, load and control records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「導向道測量角度誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Angular error in guideway surveying" is correct?
options: 同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確
先由視距與微小角度誤差估算橫向偏移，辨認長視線對控制網的影響。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.
Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 先由視距與微小角度誤差估算橫向偏移，辨認長視線對控制網的影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 導向道測量角度誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Angular error in guideway surveying: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導向道測量角度誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Angular error in guideway surveying” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「導向道測量角度誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Angular error in guideway surveying", which statement holds?
options: 幾何最大誤差一樣時所有波長的乘坐影響一定一樣
取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同

optionsEn: Equal maximum geometry error gives identical ride effects at every wavelength.
Fixed sampling frequency gives identical spatial resolution at every speed.

quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 導向道測量角度誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Angular error in guideway surveying: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導向道測量角度誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Angular error in guideway surveying” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。以「導向道測量角度誤差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. For angular error in guideway surveying, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把視線距離 distance 從 40 改成 44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1 變為 1.1 mm。先說明「導向道測量角度誤差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only sight distance distance from 40 to 44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1 to 1.1 mm. Explain the causal direction for angular error in guideway surveying, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

For angular error in guideway surveying, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把視線距離 distance 從 40 改成 44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1 變為 1.1 mm。先說明「導向道測量角度誤差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

quiz.question: 要驗證「導向道測量角度誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Angular error in guideway surveying"?
options: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
optionsEn: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
quiz.explanation: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導向道測量角度誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Angular error in guideway surveying: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導向道測量角度誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Angular error in guideway surveying” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。回到「導向道測量角度誤差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. Trace the input chain for angular error in guideway surveying. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。回到「導向道測量角度誤差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. Trace the input chain for angular error in guideway surveying. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

steps.title: 精度帳的獨立與相關成分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Independent and correlated precision terms: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」如何影響磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Independent and correlated precision terms” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guideway precision control for maglev”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把儀器重複誤差、目標安裝和基準偏移逐項分類，只有符合獨立假設者才合成標準差。共同偏移仍須另列，不能用漂亮的總數代替誤差來源說明。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Classify repeat-reading error, target installation and datum offsets before combining independent standard deviations. Keep common shifts explicit instead of replacing the error story with an attractive total. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Independent and correlated precision terms” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Classify repeat-reading error, target installation and datum offsets before combining independent standard deviations. Keep common shifts explicit instead of replacing the error story with an attractive total.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 精度帳的獨立與相關成分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Independent and correlated precision terms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Independent and correlated precision terms” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 精度帳的獨立與相關成分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Independent and correlated precision terms: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Independent and correlated precision terms” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。以「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. For independent and correlated precision terms, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立誤差一標準差 s1 從 3 改成 3.3 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變為 5.18556 mm。先說明「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for independent and correlated precision terms, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
